menuItems.name: Smokey Party Jollof Rice with Grilled Chicken & Dodo
menuItems.description: Iconic Nigerian long-grain rice infused with fire-roasted peppers, aromatic herbs and authentic firewood smoke. Served with succulent grilled quarter chicken and sweet golden plantains.

menuItems.name: Deluxe Special Fried Rice with Jumbo Prawns
menuItems.description: Stir-fried Nigerian rice with garden peas, sweet corn, diced liver, carrots, and sweet bell peppers, crowned with succulent butterflied jumbo tiger prawns.

menuItems.name: Authentic Ofada Rice with Ayamase Designer Stew
menuItems.description: Aromatic unpolished indigenous Ofada rice wrapped in fresh banana leaves, paired with fiery bleached palm oil green pepper stew, assorted bite-sized meats and boiled egg.

menuItems.name: Native Village Rice with Dried Fish & Ugba
menuItems.description: Traditional palm oil infused rice cooked with smoked mangala fish, crayfish flakes, shredded ugba (oil bean), and fresh scent leaves.

menuItems.name: Special Egusi Soup with Assorted Meats & Pounded Yam
menuItems.description: Rich hand-rolled melon seed soup simmered with dried stockfish, tender beef tripe (shaki), cowleg, bitterleaf, and fluted pumpkin. Served with pillowy smooth pounded yam.

menuItems.name: Seafood Okro Soup with Fresh Crab, Prawns & Eba
menuItems.description: Velvety chopped fresh okro loaded with fresh Atlantic blue crab, calamari rings, jumbo tiger prawns, and fresh scotch bonnet pepper. Paired with soft yellow Garri Eba.

menuItems.name: Rich Ogbono & Bitterleaf Soup with Goat Meat & Amala
menuItems.description: Smooth, deeply flavoured wild mango seed soup cooked with dry cat fish, tender goat meat and shredded bitterleaf, accompanied by soft piping hot Oyo Amala.

menuItems.name: Calabar Afang Soup with Smoked Fish & Semovita
menuItems.description: Classic Efik delight prepared with wild shredded afang leaves, waterleaves, periwinkles in their shells, beef and dried bushmeat. Served with silky smooth Semovita.

menuItems.name: Flaming Beef Suya Platter with Yaji & Sliced Red Onions
menuItems.description: Thinly sliced choice beef skewers grilled over glowing hardwood charcoal, dusted generously with authentic Northern Nigerian spiced kuli-kuli Yaji pepper, sliced onions and fresh tomatoes.

menuItems.name: Charcoal Grilled Whole Croaker Fish with Yam Chips
menuItems.description: Whole seasoned fresh Atlantic croaker fish, slow-charred over open flame with garlic, ginger and our house pepper marinade. Served with crispy fried yam chips and spicy pepper dip.

menuItems.name: Spicy Asun (Slow-Roasted Peppered Goat Meat)
menuItems.description: Tender diced goat meat roasted over open fire, tossed in habanero peppers, aromatic thyme, and caramelized sweet onions. Pure Lagos party delight.

menuItems.name: Honey Glazed Peppered Chicken Wings
menuItems.description: Crispy charcoal grilled jumbo wings tossed in a sweet-spicy reduction of Nigerian wild honey, scotch bonnet peppers, and roasted garlic.

menuItems.name: Gourmet Naija Beef & Cheese Burger with Spiced Fries
menuItems.description: Juicy 200g prime beef patty seasoned with suya spice, melted cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, fresh crisp lettuce, and spicy mayo on a toasted brioche bun with hand-cut fries.

menuItems.name: Chicken Shawarma Deluxe with Double Sausage
menuItems.description: Thin Lebanese flatbread loaded with shredded spiced chicken breast, twin beef sausages, fresh cabbage, pickled cucumbers, and our signature rich sweet garlic dressing.

menuItems.name: Royal Nigerian Golden Meat Pies (2 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Flaky golden buttery pastry baked to perfection, stuffed with finely minced beef, diced Irish potatoes, carrots, and rich savory herb gravy.

menuItems.name: Warm Sweet Puff-Puff Basket (10 Pcs)
menuItems.description: Traditional deep-fried golden yeast dough balls, soft and pillowy on the inside, lightly dusted with organic cinnamon and confectioner sugar.

menuItems.name: Artisanal Hibiscus Zobo Infusion with Cloves & Ginger
menuItems.description: Slow-brewed dried organic hibiscus calyces infused with fresh pressed ginger juice, cloves, sweet pineapple chunks, and citrus peel. Served chilled over crushed ice.

menuItems.name: Classic Lagos Chapman Mocktail
menuItems.description: Nigeria’s signature cocktail created with sparkling Fanta & Sprite, aromatic dash of Angostura bitters, fresh cucumber ribbons, and orange wedges.

menuItems.name: Caramelized Plantain Tart with Vanilla Bean Glaze
menuItems.description: Warm French pastry shell filled with spiced caramelized dodo plantains, spiced rum caramel, and a scoop of velvety vanilla bean ice cream.

reviews.comment: Hands down the best party Jollof rice in Lagos! The smoky firewood aroma was authentic and the grilled chicken was so tender. Ordering online was seamless.
The Egusi soup with pounded yam reminds me of my grandmother’s kitchen in Enugu. Generous assorted meats, perfectly seasoned. Will definitely be a regular customer!
reviews.dishOrdered: Special Egusi Soup with Pounded Yam

reviews.comment: The beef suya platter with cold Chapman is exceptional. Crisp onions, spicy yaji that hits just right. Quick delivery and beautiful packaging.
Very tasty seafood okro soup! The crab and prawns were fresh. Delivery took 35 minutes during rush hour, but food arrived piping hot.
